questions.question: Participants in the learner Persistence study were all drawn from the same

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到所有受访者都住在本地（local region），为了保持这种一致性（consistency），没有让外地人参与，因此他们来自同一个地理区域。
你可能会受到干扰，但录音中明确提到了受访者的年龄范围（range of ages）很广，且家庭背景（home background）也有显著差异，因此可以直接排除年龄和社会经济水平选项。

The sample was drawn from a range of ages, but there was deliberately a significant number of mature students, and all respondents were living at home in the local region. I wanted to have this element of consistency, not having some coming from outside the area and living in university accommodation. It should be noted, though, that there was significant variation in home background to reflect the variation in our student population.

questions.question: The study showed that when starting their course, older students were most concerned about

analyses.content: 录音提到带孩子的年长成熟学生（mature students）更强调对亲子关系的不确定性，这就直接对应了选项中对家庭生活（home life）的影响。
你可能听到了财务（financial concerns）和职业前景（career prospects），但这是大部分普遍学生的担忧，并没有特指“年长学生（older students）”的具体担忧，做单选题看选项和听条件一定要仔细匹配。

Findings from the 1st section indicated that their worries when they started varied from financial concerns, though this had not been as strong as I expected, to career prospects. But mature students with children tended to emphasize uncertainties about their relationship with them.

analyses.content: 跟上“personal characteristics”这一行，录音指出受访者在“挑战（challenge）”中获得乐趣（took pleasure in），正好对应题干的enjoyment of a challenge。
你可能会在听到pleasure时就急着填入这个看起来方向对的词，但要注意它只是同义替换了题干的enjoyment，真正享受的具体名词是后面的challenge。
And for personal characteristics, many respondents reported that they took pleasure in challenge and that this was regarded as very significant.
定位到第二重要级别（2nd level of importance）和第一个社会因素类别（1st category），录音中提到的“enjoyed themselves in school”直接对应题干的“Positive experiences at school”。
这是一道细节直接对应的题，如果你忽略了整体结构，跟丢了“2nd level”这个大标题切换作为参照物，就很容易错过这里的school。
At the 2nd level of importance, in the 1st category, a sizable percentage talked about the fact that they had enjoyed themselves in school as an important social factor.
顺着表格听到第二列的“other factors”，录音明确指出最重要的是体面的“健康（decent health）”，其中的decent完美同义替换了题干的Good。
如果你只抓大方向而没有仔细听修饰词，可能会错过答案，重点是要在听到“other factors”后马上集中注意力抓取表示好的形容词后的核心名词。
In the 2nd column, other factors, a number of people said that what was of most importance was decent health. This had a fairly strong influence on their persistence in their studies.
播报进入“personal characteristics”栏目后，录音提到在日常生活中有很多“兴趣（interests）”很重要，lots of直接替换了题干的Many。
你可能会因为没有仔细听结尾的尾音而丢分，录音中明确发了复数的音，记得填入interests而不是单数。

And then under the heading of personal characteristics, there were quite a large percentage of respondents who mentioned they felt it was important to have lots of interests in their everyday lives. This gave them a depth and sense of perspective which less persistent learners might lack.
听到“3rd level”和“social factors”定位后，录音提到受访者谈论与“导师（tutors）”有良好的关系（relationships对应题干的interaction），因此答案是tutors。
如果你死盯interaction这个词可能会等不到答案，需要识别good relationships的同义替换，并注意不能漏掉复数尾音。
And then onto the 3rd level. Under social factors, several respondents talked about good relationships with their tutors.

analyses.content: 录音提到向新生分发问卷，目的是为了了解他们在课程开始时的“成熟度（maturity）”，get an idea of 对应题干的 gauge their level of。
你可能会因为忽略了整体语义，听到starting the course就把course填进去了，但实际上这里需要评估（gauge）的是代表新生个人状态的名词maturity。
Firstly, I propose that the department distributes questionnaires to first-year students to help get an idea of their maturity when starting the course. This is really our overriding concern.
顺着路标词Secondly，录音提到为选定的学生提供培训，让他们担任（take on the role of）“顾问（advisors）”。
你可能会对“act as”这个短语形成听觉执念，必须敏锐识别到它被同义替换成了“take on the role of”，并填入准确的复数名词。
Secondly, I recommend we look into ways of offering induction courses for some selected students to allow them to take on the role of advisors. We think they are the best people to act in that role.
录音指出在晚上下班后最需要帮助（help）时，应该建立“在线服务（online services）”，结合题目不超过两个词的要求，概括为填入 online services。
录音中干扰信息很多，你可能会手快填入telephone services，但必须仔细听后面的“instead of（而不是）”，从而排除这个传统的干扰项。

Thirdly, this help is often most needed in the evening and night when offices are closed, and so we should set up online services instead of the more traditional telephone services. Research has shown that these services are actually more accessible to the majority of students.
